

```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE)
library(ggplot2)
library(dplyr)
library(readr)
library(sjPlot)
library(mgcv)
```

#Import areas and demographics
```{r}

PNC_TC_and_group_network_areas <- read.csv("../../Inputs/PNC_summary_group.csv") # n = 1598
colnames(PNC_TC_and_group_network_areas)[1] <- "participant_id"

PNC_demos <- read.csv("../../Inputs/filtered_demo_PNC.csv") #n = 1332
PNC_all <- merge(PNC_TC_and_group_network_areas,PNC_demos,by="participant_id") # n = 1332

```

#Factorize sex
```{r}
PNC_all$sex <- factor(PNC_all$sex)
```


# CLR calculation
```{r}
net_names <- paste0("PFN", 1:17, "_soft_parcel_normed")

# Compute log(network_j_area / TC_area) for all 17 networks
log_ratios <- log(PNC_all[net_names] / PNC_all$TC_area)

# Calculate the row-wise mean across all 17 networks for each participant
row_means <- rowMeans(log_ratios, na.rm = TRUE)

# Calculate CLR for all networks
clr_nets <- matrix(0,1332,17)
for (net in c(1:17)) {
  target_col <- paste0("PFN", net, "_soft_parcel_normed")
  clr_nets[,net] <- log(PNC_all[[target_col]] / PNC_all$TC_area) - row_means
}

CLR_net_names <- paste0("CLR_PFN", 1:17)
colnames(clr_nets) <- CLR_net_names
clr_nets_df <- as.data.frame(clr_nets)

PNC_all <- cbind(PNC_all, clr_nets_df)
```


## CLR models including age spline
```{r}
dout <- "../../Results/PNC_Group_Age/CLR"
dir.create(dout)

CLR_models <- list()

for (net in c(1:17)) {
  CLR_net <-  paste0("CLR_PFN",net)
  CLR_model <- gam(get(CLR_net) ~ log(TC_area)+sex+euler+median_fd_combined+s(age,k=4),data=PNC_all)
  print(summary(CLR_model))
  print(tab_model(CLR_model,pred.labels = c("Intercept","log TC Area","Sex","Euler Number","Median FD","Age Spline"),dv.labels=c(paste0("Net ",net, "- CLR")),digits=2,digits.p=2,show.se=TRUE,show.stat=TRUE,string.stat = "t",string.se = "Std. Error",show.intercept=TRUE,show.ci = FALSE, p.adjust="none",p.style="scientific", file = paste0(dout,"/PNC_Group_PFN",net,"_CLR.doc")))
  CLR_models[[net]] <- CLR_model #store all models in list
}
```

# Get significance of beta scaling term
```{r}
dout <- "../../Results/PNC_Group_Age/CLR"

CLR_results <- matrix(0,17,2)

for (net in c(1:17)) {
  net_model <- CLR_models[[net]]
  CLR_results[net,1] <- summary(net_model)$p.table["log(TC_area)", "Estimate"]
  CLR_results[net,2] <- summary(net_model)$p.table["log(TC_area)", "Pr(>|t|)"]
}

pvals_bonf <- p.adjust(CLR_results[,2], method = "bonf")
PFN_names <- c("PFN1", "PFN2", "PFN3", "PFN4", "PFN5", "PFN6", "PFN7", "PFN8", "PFN9", "PFN10", "PFN11", "PFN12", "PFN13", "PFN14", "PFN15", "PFN16", "PFN17")
CLR_bonf <-  data.frame(PFN = PFN_names, beta = CLR_results[,1], pvals_bonf = pvals_bonf)

write_csv(CLR_bonf,paste0(dout,"/PNC_Group_CLR_summary_results_bonf.csv"))
```

### Bar plot of scaling:
```{r}
p_vec_adj<- CLR_bonf[,3]
print(p_vec_adj)
keep_p <- ifelse(p_vec_adj<.05,1,0)
print(keep_p)

betas <- CLR_bonf[,2]
sorted_beta = rank(betas);
pfn_inAscend <- c()
for (t in c(1:17)) { pfn_inAscend <- append(pfn_inAscend,which(sorted_beta == t))}

# Using 7 colors scheme for bar plot
data <- data.frame(EffectSizes = as.numeric(betas)) 
data$EffectRank <- as.numeric(sorted_beta)
# BorderColor1 is for colors of 1-17 network numbers(to lable the network numbers in a 1-17 order)
BorderColor1 <- c("#E76178", "#7499C2", "#F5BA2E", "#7499C2", "#00A131",
                 "#AF33AD", "#E443FF", "#E76178", "#E443FF", "#AF33AD",
                 "#7499C2", "#E76178", "#7499C2", "#00A131", "#F5BA2E", 
                 "#4E31A8", "#F5BA2E");
				 
# BorderColor2 is for colors of bar fill 1-17 networks (in a 1-17 order). If the bar is nofill, change the code to "#FFFFFF" for that PFN. ("black" is filled with black)
BorderColor2 <- c("#FFFFFF", "#7499C2", "#F5BA2E", "#FFFFFF", "#00A131",
                 "#FFFFFF", "#E443FF", "#FFFFFF", "#E443FF", "#FFFFFF",
                 "#FFFFFF", "#E76178", "#FFFFFF", "#00A131", "#FFFFFF", 
                 "#4E31A8", "#F5BA2E");
# Change the color order
BorderColor <- BorderColor1[pfn_inAscend]
BorderColor3 <- BorderColor2[pfn_inAscend]

# the line type for the 1-17 network bars (in a 1-17 order).  If a dashed line is needed for a bar, please change the value to "dashed".
LineType <- c("dashed", "solid", "solid", "dashed", "solid",
              "dashed", "solid", "dashed", "solid", "dashed",
              "dashed", "solid", "dashed", "solid", "dashed",
              "solid", "solid");

Fig <- ggplot(data, aes(EffectRank, EffectSizes)) +
  geom_bar(stat = "identity", fill=BorderColor3[sorted_beta], 
           colour = BorderColor[sorted_beta], linetype = LineType, width = 0.8) + 
  labs(title = "Anatomical Areal Scaling- CLR", x = "Networks", y = paste0("Group Atlas Allometry")) + theme_classic() +
  theme(plot.title = ggtext::element_markdown(size=25, hjust = 0.5)) +
  theme(axis.text.x = ggtext::element_markdown(size= 25, color = BorderColor), 
        axis.text.y = ggtext::element_markdown(size= 25, color = "black"), 
        axis.title=ggtext::element_markdown(size = 25)) +
  theme(axis.text.x = ggtext::element_markdown(angle = 45, hjust = 1)) +
  scale_x_discrete(labels = as.character(pfn_inAscend),limits = as.character(sorted_beta)) +
  scale_y_continuous(
    limits = c(-0.2, 0.3) # match PFN results (more extreme betas)
  )
Fig
ggsave(paste0("../../Results/PNC_Group_Age/CLR/PNC_group_CLR_scaling_plot_0.8-1.31_bonf.png"), width = 19, height = 16, dpi = 600, units = "cm")
```
